by_code.meaning: GST-on-MDR differs from 18% of the charged fee.

examples.reason: GST charged Rs 21.58 on a fee of Rs 179.82 is 12.00%, not the statutory 18% which would be Rs 32.37. Difference -Rs 10.79. Understated GST reduces the input tax credit the merchant can legitimately claim.

Across all settled transactions, GST actually deducted was Rs 1,240.22, but 18% of the Rs 6,949.90 of fees charged would be Rs 1,250.98 — GST is understated by Rs 10.76. Every rupee of understated GST is a rupee of input tax credit the merchant cannot claim.
